metadata.question: Was the Swannanoa River visibly browner on October 2, 2024, than on August 30, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 MSI (10 m, 5-day revisit) for true-colour and turbidity-sensitive bands. – Date 1: 2024-08-30 (±3 days) – Date 2: 2024-10-02 (±3 days) – Location: Swannanoa River near Asheville, NC (35.601 °N, 82.552 °W). 2. Masking: Apply Sentinel-2 QA60 cloud-shadow mask; keep images with <30 % cover inside a 1 km buffer. 3. Browner water proxy: – Ratio “brownness” = Red / Green (B4 / B3) – higher ratio → more suspended sediment / organic stain → browner. – Compute median of this ratio inside a 200 m-wide river buffer derived from 2024 JRC monthly water layer. – Require ≥50 valid river pixels on both dates; if either date fails → C2. – If both ratios are valid, compare: if Oct-02 ratio > Aug-30 ratio → A (Yes), else B (No). – If any ratio is None / NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. River mask (JRC 2024 monthly water) jrc=ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory/2024_09').select('water').eq(2) riv=jrc.focal_max(3).focal_min(3).updateMask(jrc) # 90 m → ~200 m buffer riv=riv.reproject(crs='EPSG:4326',scale=30) def ratio(img): return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=riv.geometry().intersection(buf), scale=30,maxPixels=1e9).get('brown') augVal=augBrown.median().multiply(riv).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buf, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('brown').getInfo() octVal=octBrown.median().multiply(riv).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buf, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('brown').getInfo() pix=riv.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),geometry=buf,scale=30).get('water').getInfo() if augVal is None or octVal is None or pix<50: print("No valid river pixels.") print("C2") print(f"Aug30 brown ratio: {augVal:.3f}") print(f"Oct02 brown ratio: {octVal:.3f}") print(f"Valid river pixels: {int(pix)}") if octVal>augVal: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-82.552, 35.601])          # Swannanoa R. near Asheville
buf = pt.buffer(1000)                               # 1 km search buffer
aug = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')\
          .filterBounds(buf)\
          .filterDate('2024-08-27','2024-09-02')\
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',30))
oct = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')\
          .filterBounds(buf)\
          .filterDate('2024-09-29','2024-10-05')\
          .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',30))

if aug.size().getInfo()==0 or oct.size().getInfo()==0:
    print("Missing images for one date.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")

# 2. Cloud mask & brownness ratio
def.maskAndBrown(ic):
    def proc(img):
        qa=img.select('QA60')
        mask=qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<10).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1<<11)).Not()
        brown=img.select('B4').divide(img.select('B3')).rename('brown')
        return brown.updateMask(mask)
    return ic.map(proc)

augBrown=maskAndBrown(aug)
octBrown=maskAndBrown(oct)

# 3. River mask (JRC 2024 monthly water)
jrc=ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory/2024_09').select('water').eq(2)
riv=jrc.focal_max(3).focal_min(3).updateMask(jrc)  # 90 m → ~200 m buffer
riv=riv.reproject(crs='EPSG:4326',scale=30)

def ratio(img):
    return img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=riv.geometry().intersection(buf),
                            scale=30,maxPixels=1e9).get('brown')

augVal=augBrown.median().multiply(riv).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buf, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9)\
        .get('brown').getInfo()
octVal=octBrown.median().multiply(riv).reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=buf, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9)\
        .get('brown').getInfo()

pix=riv.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),geometry=buf,scale=30).get('water').getInfo()
if augVal is None or octVal is None or pix<50:
    print("No valid river pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

print(f"Aug30 brown ratio: {augVal:.3f}")
print(f"Oct02 brown ratio: {octVal:.3f}")
print(f"Valid river pixels: {int(pix)}")

if octVal>augVal:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
